en: Added syncing of the skills and plugins enabled on your claude.ai account to terminal sessions signed in with it; opt out with `syncClaudeAiSkills: false` or `syncClaudeAiPlugins: false`
zh: 新增将 claude.ai 账号中启用的 skill 和 plugin 同步到使用该账号登录的终端 session；可通过 `syncClaudeAiSkills: false` 或 `syncClaudeAiPlugins: false` 关闭
